reason: I've already been burned by Jamku and desktop ERPs that ended up abandoned after two months, and I'm deeply skeptical about connecting an external tool to our firm's Google Drive. Even with folder isolation promises, I will only ever test the free sandbox on dummy files rather than paying for a software subscription upfront.
objection: Will connecting my Google Drive give Docketra access to read all my firm's private files?
would_change_my_mind: A trusted peer recommendation from my local ICAI study circle and verifiable proof on Google's OAuth consent screen that permissions are strictly limited to files created by the app.
